decision_scope: Whether the outcome contract can represent the exact authoritative qualitative_coding Project Graph identity and resolve it through the real portfolio owner without weakening outcome or lineage slugs.

implementation.seam: OutcomeContractV1 validates project_id separately; outcome_id, lineage_id, predecessor lineage IDs, owner class, and all other validation remain on their prior owner.

authentic_project_graph_probe.mode: ephemeral exact-claim and isolated ledger using the candidate code; Project Meta was read only at the exact revision below

uppercase_project.error: project_id must be a canonical lowercase Project Graph identifier

path_project.error: project_id must be a canonical lowercase Project Graph identifier

repeated_separator_project.error: project_id must be a canonical lowercase Project Graph identifier

underscore_outcome.error: outcome_id must be a portable lowercase identifier

underscore_lineage.error: lineage_id must be a portable lowercase identifier

acceptance.QCOP01B-A1: accepted: exact qualitative_coding validates and an isolated authentic allocation resolves the exact pinned reviewed Project Graph record through the production portfolio owner
acceptance.QCOP01B-A2: accepted: hyphenated and underscore project IDs pass while uppercase, whitespace, paths, traversal, leading/trailing/repeated, and adjacent mixed separators are covered by focused controls
acceptance.QCOP01B-A3: accepted: outcome and lineage underscore controls still fail on the unchanged portable slug owner
acceptance.QCOP01B-A4: accepted: the candidate changes one source validator, focused tests, Plan 124 evidence/status, and its park request; QC, installer, hook, model, deployment, and user-data surfaces remain unchanged

non_mutation.shared_portfolio_probe_effect: none; the real-record allocation used an isolated temporary ledger

terminal_closeout: The candidate is accepted for merge. Merge and append the prepared parked disposition to the shared source allocation before QCOP-02 starts; retain the post-park ledger and admission denial as PR evidence.
promotion_decision: After canonical merge and terminal source-allocation park, QCOP-02 may create its separately governed QC plan lane. This evidence does not license installer defaults or fleet propagation.
